verdict.rationale: pnpm documents first-class monorepo support: the workspace: protocol, which resolves only to local workspace packages and is rewritten to real versions on publish, plus filtering, catalogs, per-package settings, and a single lockfile for everything. Community users migrating 20+ package monorepos from Lerna report that the built-in monorepo support just works, though some note occasional symlink glitches. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the shared single-lockfile behavior beyond a homepage claim.
